info.title: CircleUp indexer HTTP API
info.description: Read-only, unauthenticated HTTP API. Amounts are decimal stroop strings; PostgreSQL BIGINT ledgers can be strings while computed ledger fields are numbers. Unknown response properties are compatible additions. Errors preserve both legacy string and structured {message,details} envelopes. Retained DB records are not pruned. Public histories default page=1, limit=20, maximum=100; invalid repeated, non-integer, or oversized paging parameters return 400.

get.description: HTTP 200 when serviceStatus is healthy or legacy status is ok; otherwise HTTP 503. Component status is ok, degraded, or error. This checks DB, RPC, lag, schema, contract drift, and skipped events.
